import bpy
exec("""
# Audit the terrain and accepted vessel after the saved relief rebuild.
bpy.context.view_layer.update();bv=BVHTree.FromObject(terrain,bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get());rows=[]
for name in ['R20_UpperHull','R20_LowerHull','R20_HullBottom']:
 ob=bpy.data.objects[name]
 for poly in ob.data.polygons:
  ps=[ob.data.vertices[i].co for i in poly.vertices]
  for pp in ps+[sum(ps,Vector())/len(ps)]:
   p=ob.matrix_world@pp
   if p.z>.6:continue
   hit,n,idx,dist=bv.ray_cast(Vector((p.x,p.y,25)),Vector((0,0,-1)),60)
   if hit:rows.append(p.z-hit.z)
assert min(rows)>.25
terrain.data.calc_loop_triangles();inverted=0
for tri in terrain.data.loop_triangles:
 a,b,c=[terrain.data.vertices[i].co for i in tri.vertices]
 inverted+=int((b-a).cross(c-a).z<=0)
assert not inverted
report={'cargo_samples':len(rows),'cargo_minimum_clearance':min(rows),'terrain_inverted_faces':inverted,'source_dirty':bpy.data.is_dirty,'terrain_components':len(bpy.data.collections['Reference_Terrain'].objects)}
(LOG/'source_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8');print(report)
""",bpy.app.driver_namespace['relief20'])
